Reply_CacheProblem.description: A local cache or recording failure, independent of what the provider returned.

Reply_DrugFdaSort.description: Drugs@FDA application order; omitted keeps the source's own order.

Reply_DrugNameSelector.description: One explicit ChEMBL name filter without fallback or synonym expansion.
x-enum-descriptions: Match the native preferred name exactly, ignoring case.
Match an explicit native synonym exactly, ignoring case.

Reply_DrugRecallClassification.description: FDA's native recall classification, with no local ranking.

Reply_DrugSafetyCommunication.description: One FDA Drug Safety Communication, as FDA's index lists it and its page links it.

applications.description: Drugs@FDA application numbers the page links, as FDA links them (digits only).

date.description: The date FDA's index lists, when it reads as a full date.

drugs.description: The drug names those Drugs@FDA links show, as FDA wrote them.

id.description: FDA's own identifier for the communication's page, stable when its address moves.

issued.description: The date the communication's page states for itself, when the page was read.

matched_in.description: Places that matched the search name. Omitted on an unfiltered list or get.

page_read.description:
False when the page has not been read yet, so `issued`, `updated`, `applications` and
`drugs` are not known; the row then matches by its title only.

updated.description: The page's "Content current as of" date: its last update, not its issue date.

Reply_DrugSafetyCommunicationPage.description: A bounded page of FDA Drug Safety Communications, newest first.

hint.description: What the list holds and where FDA's text comes from.

list_starts.description: The oldest date on FDA's index: FDA links an archived copy for earlier communications.

seed_date.description: The date of the list BioMCP ships; rows FDA added later come from FDA's index.

text_searched.description: Communications whose page text was available to search.

Reply_DrugSafetyMatch.description: Where an FDA communication matched the requested name or one of its other names.

Reply_DrugSearch.description: Search one drug source. FDA drug recalls accept a name or native firm, classification, status, reason and initiation dates; counts are recall records. WHO prequalification accepts a name, area or date range. openFDA labels also accept literal indication or mechanism wording. Drugs@FDA accepts a name or an applicant. Other sources require a name. Purple Book takes a reference name or BLA and summarizes biosimilars by product.

applicant.description: Case-insensitive sponsor_name prefix, without company-family or subsidiary inference. A drug name narrows the search.

application_type.description: Keep label application_number prefixes, e.g. nda,bla to exclude generics (ANDA).

approved_from.description: Earliest original_approval, inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Reads all matches and counts those in the window.

approved_to.description: Latest original_approval, inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

device.description: Filter presentations by device cell, ignoring case.

exact_term.description: Use only the typed name. Default name widening applies to openFDA labels, Drugs@FDA, FDA recalls and safety communications, and EMA.

expand_drug_names.description: Accepted for one release. Name widening is already automatic where supported.

firm.description: Exact phrase in the published recall firm name.

indication.description: Exact Indications and Usage wording, without disease synonyms. A drug name narrows the search.

limit.description: Rows per page. Purple Book product summaries always return the full roster.

mechanism_of_action.description: Exact Mechanism of Action wording, without synonyms or drug class inference.

name_selector.description: ChEMBL name to match. Default: preferred name.

name_snapshot.description: Continue the first page's names and search step. Copy the returned token and keep filters unchanged.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Purple Book applies this only to presentation rows.

prequalified_from.description: Earliest WHO prequalification date, inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

prequalified_to.description: Latest WHO prequalification date, inclusive (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

presentations.description: Return presentation rows, as do --strength and --device.

query.description:
Drug name phrase. Omit for recall, safety communication, WHO date, label indication or mechanism, or Drugs@FDA applicant searches.
Drugs@FDA matches brands and ingredients, exact names first. openFDA labels match brands and generics, exact names first,
then search label text (including indications) if no names match. Recall aliases can match without becoming display names.
Safety communications match titles, linked drug names and available text. Replies count records searched and records with page text.
A communication can exist even when the search returns zero matches.

sort.description:
newest sorts by latest submission status date, which may be for a supplement.
original-approval reads all matches and sorts by original_approval. Both put recent dates first,
break ties by application number and put undated rows last. Omit for source order.

source.description: Drug source. An empty name search may retry names from other sources.

strength.description: Filter presentations by strength cell, ignoring case and spaces.

therapeutic_area.description: Match whole words in WHO's Therapeutic Area column, ignoring case (e.g. Oncology).

Reply_Incomplete.description: One thing a `partial` reply is missing, pointing at the detail already in the reply.

at.description: JSON pointer into this reply, such as `/sources/1` or a record's field.

code.description: The refused record's own problem code, when a problem is the cause.

reason.description: Why, when a typed source reason is known.

source.description: The source whose data is missing.

Reply_LabelApplicationType.description: An openFDA label's FDA application type, read from the prefix of openFDA's application_number.

Reply_PageInfo.description: Search counts after filtering and deduplication.

total.description: Total matches: the source's own count when one source states more than the snapshot holds, otherwise the identities held by this snapshot.

truncated.description: Matching source count exceeded the retrieved window.

Reply_PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Reply_PoolInfo.description: Fixed lifetime and size of a stored search snapshot.

created.description: Publication wall time in Unix seconds.

expires.description: Fixed expiry wall time in Unix seconds.

Reply_Problem.description: A field that could not be accepted from a source record.

code.description: Why the field value was not accepted.

record.description:
The record's canonical identifier, when known. A `record.declined` problem has none, so
it names the record by a source key, such as `event_id:100178`.

source.description: The source that supplied the record.

Reply_ProblemCode.description: A stable code for a rejected field value.
x-enum-descriptions: The field value was not recognized.
Native collection exceeds the admitted complete source page.
A source repeats one exact identity with incompatible records.
A source record without a usable identity was left off the page; each problem names one such record.
The asked filter cannot read the records the field names, so they were not searched and may hold matches the page leaves out.

Reply_Reason.description: Why a source could not supply data.
x-enum-descriptions: The requested record was not found.
The public bucket does not hold an open text record.
Publisher response is not a PDF.
The local reader does not support the file or container format.
The response exceeds an explicit reader resource bound.
The source limited the request rate.
The local source quota refused admission without a network request.
Platform or configured certificate verification failed.
Connecting to or negotiating the configured proxy failed.
The reply could not be used.
The source data was being synchronized.
Identity lacks the identifier required to join this source.
The source document was read but does not state the value.

Reply_Source.description: A source of BioMCP data, identified by its canonical short name.
x-enum-descriptions: ChEMBL native records and carried component.
WHO Model List of Essential Medicines, from the WHO eEML.
MyChem DrugBank Open identity subset only.
openFDA FAERS drug adverse event reports.
Source-reported MedDRA reaction labels and versions.
NCBI Genetic Testing Registry public reports.
openFDA medical device product recall records.
FDA Drug Safety Communications web pages.
FDA Purple Book biologic product roster.
Public cBioPortal with study-specific reuse terms.
Orphadata Science epidemiology and natural-history files.

Reply_SourceNotice.description: A source notice or request recovery step.

message.description: Why the names were expanded or retained.

names.description: Names actually searched; ambiguous identities retain the typed name only.

oneOf.description: Variant spellings and registry fields actually searched.

codon.description: Codon forms searched, which match trials written for any change at that position.

input.description: Whole caller-supplied variant or criteria text.

message.description: What was searched, where, and how to search the typed text only.

spellings.description: Spellings of the same change actually searched, including the typed text.

oneOf.description: Local request limits, source observations and recovery guidance.

data_date.description: Retained publisher dataset date, independent of acquisition and record events.

message.description: Reviewed guidance; any quoted provider wording remains source data.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds left before another source request may be admitted.

oneOf.description: Registered conditions lack the literal words requested in a condition search.

message.description: The source searches several fields and can expand terms; no expansion cause is inferred.

oneOf.description: A checked provider answer survived a local cache failure.

reason.description: Bounded local failure without paths or database diagnostics.

oneOf.description: The source still has graph pages after the bounded fetch window.

fallback.description: Default-source command offering another graph view.

oneOf.description: An empty LitVar lookup can be repeated with a caller-supplied rsID.

message.description: Guidance that never supplies or infers an rsID.

oneOf.description: PubMed supplied a named ESearch warning without changing its phrases.

name.description: Original provider warning name, including names added by PubMed later.

phrases.description: Original provider phrases, preserving whitespace and quotes.

oneOf.description: PubMed did not index these words.

Reply_SourceOutcome.description: One source's outcome with source notices and request guidance.

notices.description: Source notices and request recovery guidance.

use.description: Reviewed source use category; publisher terms remain authoritative: see `help sources`.

Reply_SourceState.description: State of a source actually asked by the command.

Reply_Step.description: A command argument list spelled from a typed action.

options.description:
Options this call also takes, each with a placeholder to fill in, such as
`"--decision-from": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"`; add any of them to `args`. MCP names them as tool
arguments. Absent when the step is only runnable as it is.

Reply_StepKind.description: Purpose of an available next command.

Reply_Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

Reply_Use.description: Reviewed source-use category, without inferring rights in individual records.

description:
One versioned command response; schema identity comes only from its body type.
JSON readers ignore unknown fields and unknown growable enum values within a major.

absent.description: IDs a get of several did not find while it found others; each item says so too.

fields.description:
The row fields the caller chose with `--fields`, as given; absent without them.
Each row keeps those, its required keys and identifiers; other keys are left out.

incomplete.description: What a `partial` reply is missing; present only on `partial` replies.

local_error.description: Bounded local cache or recording failure, independent of provider outcomes.

page.description: Search page metadata. With zero results, `total` and `returned` are 0 and the result leaves out `items`, because replies omit empty lists.
